messages:
kevin_support: Heads up — getting multiple support tickets reporting 504s + 5xx from hosted inference in us-east-1 since ~23:12 UTC. p95 latency climbing, some customers seeing streaming timeouts. Opening triage thread.

tim_ops: On it. Pulling gateway traces and batcher metrics now. Any common path or recent deploys?

kevin_support: Mostly POST /v1/generate for high-throughput customers. Also one auth 502 seen for billing checks. Pasting one failing curl:```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -d '{"model":"rwd-13b","input":"hello"}' -v``` Response: HTTP/1.1 504 

anya_sre: Can you drop a raw request id + last 3 logs for a failed request? I'll check kv-cache hits and model runtime traces.

kevin_support: request_id=rid_20260317_2315_82ab 
logs: "batcher: enqueue len=94 max_batch=64", "kvcache: miss spike=0.42->0.77", "runtime: kernel quantize switch applied"

deploy-bot: Canary rollout: rwd-runtime-v2 -> 20% (canary group) @ 22:45 UTC 

oncall-matt: That canary change rings a bell. If runtime kernel changed, combined with larger batching it could blow up tail latency. Recommend immediate rollback if correlated.

tim_ops: Correlation check: canary nodes show p95 9-12s, stable nodes 1-2s. Batcher request sizes for canary: mean_batch=48 -> spikes to 90. Suggest temporary reduce max_batch to 8 on canary and scale batcher workers +50% in us-east-1.

anya_sre: I'm applying circuit-breaker for requests > 5s to fail fast and avoid long queues. Pushing batcher scale + config: ```batcher.scale(us-east-1, +50%)
batcher.set_config(canary, {"max_batch_size": 8, "dispatch_window_ms": 10})```

kevin_support: Doing customer triage: affected = [cust-alpha, cust-beta, cust-gamma]. Cust-beta CSM pinged. Preparing templated comms.

lucy_prod: Please include ETA for rollback + mitigation in comms. Customers asking for root-cause now.

tim_ops: Rolling back canary to 0% now (rolling restart of canary nodes).

deploy-bot: Canary rollback initiated by tim_ops @ 23:28 UTC

deploy-bot: Canary rollback completed @ 23:30 UTC

anya_sre: Post-rollback metrics: p95 dropped 11.2s -> 1.8s over 5 minutes, error rate back to baseline. KV miss rate trending down. Looks like runtime change + autoscaler interaction caused batch size balloon -> kv pressure -> timeouts.

kevin_support: Mitigation summary for incident log: - Scaled batcher +50% in us-east-1 - Reduced canary max_batch to 8 (temp) - Enabled request circuit-breaker for long tail - Rolled back runtime canary to stable - Notified customers and CSMs

lucy_prod: Thanks. Action items (assign): 1) Add an automated alert for sudden mean_batch_size > threshold (owner: tim_ops) 2) Add explicit rollback step in canary runbook and auto-rollback threshold (owner: oncall-matt) 3) Add synthetic canary tests with variable sequence lengths and traffic profiles (owner: lucy_prod) 4) Instrument request-level batch_id in traces for easier correlation (owner: anya_sre) 5) Update customer comms template (owner: kevin_support)

kevin_support: I'll open the postmortem doc and put the summary/links. Drafting comms now :memo:

incident-bot: Incident created: INCIDENT-20260317-NE-5XX-NIGHTWAVE. Severity: Sev2.

anya_sre: Early root cause notes for postmortem: runtime kernel selection change in v2 + canary autoscaler/config allowed batch sizes to grow under synthetic/real customer patterns -> large KV cache miss amplification and head-of-line blocking in batcher -> timeouts.

tim_ops: Short-term fixes pushed. Medium-term: change autoscaler policy to consider mean_batch_size and kv_miss_rate, not only CPU. Also enforce conservative default max_batch for canary/runtime changes.

oncall-matt: I'll add a runbook step: before kernel/runtime canary, run a scale-test with high qps/seqlen mix to validate batching behavior.

lucy_prod: Customer comms sent (cust list above) with ETA and mitigation summary. Will follow up with postmortem when available.

kevin_support: Postmortem draft link: https://docs.redwood.com/postmortems/INCIDENT-20260317-NE-5XX-NIGHTWAVE (draft). Please add notes and assign owners.

anya_sre: Proposed timeline in doc + recommended fixes + test cases added. Request review by EOD.

kevin_support: Thanks all — closing war room. Will reopen if anything regresses. :thumbsup:
